title: Dog Muzzle, Soft Air Mesh Muzzles For Large Sized Dogs, Breathable Dog Mussels For Scavenging Biting Licking & Barking, Adjustable Mouth Guard For Grooming, Allows Panting And Drinking
body_html:
• 【3D AIR MESH: BREATHABLE & LIGHTWEIGHT】：Say goodbye to overheating! Crafted from premium 3D Air Mesh, this soft muzzle ensures maximum ventilation. The edges are reinforced with soft padding to prevent friction and "nose rub," providing zero-burden comfort for long-term wear during professional grooming or vet visits.
  • 【SECURE & ADJUSTABLE: ESCAPE-PROOF FIT】：Featuring a high-strength quick-release buckle and adjustable nylon straps to ensure the muzzle stays firmly in place. The hook-and-loop (velcro) snout strap allows for a customized, snug fit tailored to your dog’s unique shape—ideal for German Shepherds, Labradors, and Huskies.
  • 【VERSATILE USE & EASY CARE】：Designed for indoor and outdoor activities, from nail trimming at home to high-traffic urban walks. This foldable, lightweight muzzle is machine washable and quick-drying. Note: Please measure your dog's snout circumference and length as per our size chart to ensure the perfect fit.
  • ATTENTION: It is not suitable for short-snouted breeds like shih tzu, pit bull and boxer.
